project_type: Django 4.x + DRF + Channels SaaS backend; React 18 + Vite 5 + TanStack Query frontend
build_system: Django manage.py (backend); Vite + tsc (frontend). No monorepo tool.
test_framework: Django TestCase / TransactionTestCase (backend). No frontend test runner configured.
verification_instructions: 1. From backend/: python manage.py check --settings=config.settings; 2. python manage.py makemigrations --check; 3. python manage.py test --settings=config.test_settings; 4. From frontend/: npm run build; npm run lint
snapshot_or_generated_files: Migration files under backend/<app>/migrations/. Run `python manage.py makemigrations` to generate. Run `python manage.py migrate --run-syncdb` to apply.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell: use semicolons not && for command chaining in shell. Test settings at config/test_settings.py use SQLite :memory: and DisableMigrations. CONN_MAX_AGE=60 already set in settings.py. Redis on localhost:6379 (password via REDIS_PASSWORD env var). Docker Compose has postgres + redis only.
contribution_requirements: No push to git. Commit locally only. Safe migrations only (AddIndex, no raw SQL drops, no data deletion). Never cache payments/accounting/audit as authoritative state. transaction.on_commit() for all cache invalidation. select_for_update() for all financial mutations.
key_patterns: Service layer pattern: views call services/selectors, never build querysets directly. Access control in <app>/access.py. Permissions in <app>/permissions.py. Pagination via core.pagination.SafePageNumberPagination (page_size=20, max=100). Cache module at common/caching/ (services, keys, policies, invalidation). TimestampedModel base in core/models.py. UUID PKs on all business models. DecimalField for all monetary values.
directory_structure: backend/ — Django project root. backend/config/ — settings, urls, asgi, celery. backend/common/caching/ — full cache module already built. backend/<app>/ — one Django app per domain (orders, billing, payments, inventory, menu, kitchen, notifications, reporting, accounting, financials, central_control, operations, enterprise, crm, marketing, recipes). backend/tests/ — cross-app performance tests (test_cache, test_concurrency, test_queries, test_pagination). frontend/src/ — React app. frontend/src/pages/ — one subdirectory per domain, all lazy-loaded. frontend/src/hooks/ — custom hooks including useDebounce. frontend/src/services/ — Axios API service layer. performance/ — locust scenarios (scenarios/ and test_data/ subdirectories exist, files TBD). docs/ — project documentation.
